title: Neural Stochastic Forecasting for Lateral Molecular Diffusion Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2611.06157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting the long-time diffusion of membrane proteins is challenging because molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are computationally expensive, while experimental single-particle tracking is often limited by finite observation times. Here, we introduce a neural stochastic (NS) model for forecasting the collective diffusion of membrane proteins from coarse-grained MD trajectories. The model combines a transformer-based representation of protein configurations, recurrent networks operating at multiple temporal scales, and a stochastic latent process with learned memory. A cross-attention decoder then generates correlated protein displacements while accounting for the instantaneous system geometry and periodic boundary conditions. We evaluate the model in two membrane systems: seven interacting PIEZO channels and a mixed system containing seven PIEZO and ten TREK channels. translated_title: 用于侧向分子扩散模拟的神经随机预测方法
translated_abstract: 预测膜蛋白的长时间扩散具有挑战性，因为分子动力学（MD）模拟的计算成本高昂，而实验中的单粒子跟踪通常又受限于有限的观察时间。在此，我们提出了一种神经随机（NS）模型，用于从粗粒化MD轨迹预测膜蛋白的集体扩散。该模型结合了基于Transformer的蛋白质构象表示、在多个时间尺度上运行的循环网络，以及具有学习记忆功能的随机潜过程。随后，交叉注意力解码器在考虑系统瞬时几何构型和周期性边界条件的情况下，生成相关的蛋白质位移。我们在两个膜系统中对该模型进行了评估：一个是七个相互作用的PIEZO通道系统，另一个是包含七个PIEZO通道和十个TREK通道的混合系统。对于七PIEZO系统，NS模型重现了异常（扩散行为）……
tldr: 提出了一种结合Transformer构象表示、多时间尺度循环网络和带学习记忆的随机潜过程的神经随机模型，能够从粗粒化分子动力学轨迹高效预测膜蛋白在膜内的长时间集体扩散。
en_tdlr: A neural stochastic model combining transformer-based configuration representations, multi-timescale recurrent networks, and a stochastic latent process with learned memory efficiently forecasts the long-time collective diffusion of membrane proteins from coarse-grained MD trajectories.
